title: Decisions
bridge: `if (x > 5) { } else if (...) { } else { }` with `&&`, `||`, `!`. C# has a neat **switch expression**: `string day = n switch { 1 => "Monday", 2 => "Tuesday", _ => "?" };` (`_` is "anything else").

exercises.title: Grades
exercises.prompt: Write Grade(int score) in class Grades: 80+ "A", 65+ "B", 50+ "C", 40+ "D", else "E"; "invalid" below 0 or above 100.
hints: Or a switch expression: score switch { < 0 or > 100 => "invalid", >= 80 => "A", ... }

exercises.title: Leap years
exercises.prompt: Write IsLeap(int year) in class Leap (divisible by 4, except by 100, except by 400).

quiz.why: The discard pattern matches everything left.

quiz.why: && (and the word 'and' works only inside patterns).

explain: Explain decisions to someone who has never programmed, in your own words, with an example you make up.
